Hauntingly Beautiful Halloween Decor

Transform your space with the Member's Mark 26'' Prelit Skeleton Wreath, a perfect blend of rustic charm and gothic elegance. The glowing red LED eyes add a supernatural touch, creating a spine-tingling ambiance for your evening gatherings or trick-or-treaters.

Rich, Layered Design

Every detail of this wreath evokes autumnal decay and Halloween magic. The deep burgundy, burnt sienna, and aged gold foliage, combined with twisted twigs and delicate ferns, create a forest-floor effect. Weathered bones, dark pumpkins, faux berries, and textured accents like green burlap and black “fur” enhance its macabre charm. Metallic touches, such as gold-dusted leaves, add depth and realism to the design.

The built-in 6-hour timer ensures hassle-free operation, automatically turning the lights on and off for energy efficiency. Perfect for busy holiday hosts, this feature lets you enjoy the spooky ambiance without the need for manual adjustments.

Durable and Versatile Design

Crafted with high-quality artificial materials, this 24-inch wreath is built to last for seasons. Its fade-resistant foliage, long-lasting lights, and intricate skull details ensure it remains a standout piece year after year. Whether hung on doors, walls, or mantels, it adapts seamlessly to various Halloween themes, from haunted house vibes to chic gothic aesthetics.

Complete Your Halloween Setup

Pair the Member's Mark 26'' Prelit Skeleton Wreath with jack-o’-lanterns, cobweb garlands, or black taper candles to create a cohesive and striking Halloween display. This bold statement piece bridges the gap between autumn charm and spooky season spirit, making it an essential addition to your holiday decor.

title: 73in Louvered Privacy Planter With Wheels Mobile Metal Raised Garden Bed Trellis Screen Outdoor
body_html:
This 73-inch tall louvered privacy planter combines a planter box and privacy screen into one, creating a secluded green sanctuary for your patio, deck, or poolside. The louvered design effectively blocks neighbors' views while allowing airflow and natural light to pass through. Paired with a trellis and lockable wheels, you can easily create your own "living wall" anywhere.

Product Features

  • Louvered Privacy Design: 73-inch tall louvered screen effectively shields your space from neighbors while allowing breeze and light to filter through—perfect for creating a cozy private outdoor retreat; ideal for climbing ivy, roses, or jasmine to build a lush, year-round green barrier

  • Mobile Caster Wheels: Equipped with 4 heavy-duty swivel casters (2 with brakes) for easy relocation to chase sunlight or clean the deck; "Step-to-Lock" system keeps the planter rock-solid even in windy conditions

  • Reinforced Anti-Tip Structure: Triangular side-brace + extra center-support beam double reinforcement—prevents sagging and tipping even when fully loaded with wet soil and tall, heavy plants

  • Scientific Drainage System: Features 4 upgraded 0.4-inch drainage holes at the corners (instead of just 2)—ensures optimal root oxygen circulation and prevents root rot; scientifically sized holes retain soil while keeping your patio floors clean and dry

  • Premium Metal Construction: Made of powder-coated metal, rust-proof and mold-free; every edge is precision-polished smooth and burr-free—safe for handling, built for years of premium gardening experience

  • "Living Wall" Planting Guide: We recommend hardy climbers like English Ivy or Star Jasmine on the trellis, paired with low-maintenance Snake Plants or Boxwoods in the planter box—creating a vibrant, secluded sanctuary that stays green and private through every season

Product Specifications

  • Overall Height: 73 inches / approx. 185cm

  • Drainage Holes: 4 holes (0.4 inches each)

  • Casters: 4 swivel casters (2 with brake lock)
